entries.title: Denmark: Top court backs hardline immigration "ghetto law"

entries.snippet: Tajikistan has initiated its withdrawal from the International Criminal Court as the US calls for it to be "dismantled." The decision was made during a recent visit from Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entries.title: After Japan's APEC snub, what's next for its China ties?

entries.title: Gukesh to defend chess crown against rising star Sindarov
entries.snippet: As the World Chess championship gets underway, it's no coincidence that the titleholder, Gukesh Dommaraju, and his challenger, Jakhovir Sindarov, are both from Asia.

entries.title: Nepal's new PM eyes closer ties with India amid lingering disputes
entries.snippet: On his first foreign bilateral visit, rapper-turned-Prime Minister Balendra Shah sought deeper ties with Nepal's neighbor and largest trading partner, while steering clear of sticky territorial issues.

entries.snippet: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring back the disgraced CEO, who resigned this month amid news of his affairs. He's suspected of having had a relationship with a Chinese intelligence asset.

entries.title: North Macedonia remains stalled on its EU path after 21 years as a candidate

entries.title: COP deadlock prompts calls for a reset of climate diplomacy
entries.snippet: COP31 has been branded a failure after countries couldn't reach a final agreement, divided over a reference to "fossil fuels." But was the decision to walk away from a watered-down text actually a show of strength?

entries.title: German police respond to multiple school bomb threats
entries.snippet: Police in Germany are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools, but say that at present they don't believe them to be credible. Danish authorities are reporting a similar series of apparent hoaxes.

entries.title: 'I've lost her forever' — Why German voice actors are refusing to sign Netflix's AI contract
entries.snippet: For decades, Germans have known Hollywood's biggest stars through the same familiar voices. Now an AI clause in Netflix contracts is splitting the industry over whether it protects performers or exposes them.

entries.title: Budget cuts threaten Germany's fight against antisemitism and racism
entries.snippet: Numerous grassroots initiatives in Germany are facing funding cuts. Affected organizations are sounding the alarm, pointing to growing challenges posed by far-right extremism.

entries.title: Germany's Early Start Pension: Can child investment accounts help?
entries.snippet: Germany plans to pay €10 a month into investment accounts for children to encourage long-term retirement saving. Economists say the measure may help build wealth but won't solve the country's pension funding challenge.

entries.title: NATO Parliamentary Assembly convenes amid Russian airspace violations

entries.title: Ukraine updates: Kyiv claims strike that sank Russian ship off Libya
